text: 华泰证券研报指出，AI链高景气和季末出货共同推动韩国9月出口同比攀至83.5%，较8月的68.7%提高14.8个百分点；日均出口同比增长104.7%。其中，狭义AI链（半导体和计算机）贡献了约九成的出口增长，非AI链出口也较8月有所修复。出口强势推动韩国三季度贸易顺差达1153亿美元、对名义GDP增长的贡献约19.6个百分点。展望四季度，全球制造业动能偏强叠加AI链需求仍有望支撑韩国出口高增，但随着同比基数逐月抬升、存储价格环比涨幅收窄，韩国出口增速进一步上行的空间或受限。
text_en: A Huatai Securities research report pointed out that the high prosperity of the AI chain and quarter-end shipments jointly pushed South Korea's September exports up 83.5% year-on-year, 14.8 percentage points higher than August's 68.7%; average daily exports rose 104.7% year-on-year. Among them, the narrow AI chain (semiconductors and computers) contributed about 90% of export growth, while non-AI chain exports also recovered somewhat from August. Strong exports pushed South Korea's third-quarter trade surplus to $115.3 billion, contributing about 19.6 percentage points to nominal GDP growth. Looking ahead to the fourth quarter, strong global manufacturing momentum combined with AI chain demand is still expected to support high growth in South Korean exports, but as the year-on-year base rises month by month and the month-on-month increase in memory prices narrows, the room for further acceleration in South Korea's export growth may be limited.
